title: Dental PPO Plans Secondary Payment Method and Rounding Convention
content:
Each of the Dental PPO Plans states how it pays when it is the secondary plan and how computed amounts are rounded.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secondary payment method | Non-duplication | Non-duplication | Non-duplication | Standard coordination of benefits | Standard coordination of benefits | Standard coordination of benefits |
| Rounding | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent |

**Non-duplication.** The plan pays its normal benefit minus the primary payment, never below 0.00.

**Standard coordination of benefits.** The plan pays the lesser of its normal benefit and the remaining balance of the allowed amount after the primary payment.

**Rounding.** Each computed line amount is rounded to the nearest cent, halves rounded up.

### Hypothetical comparison
For a line with a normal benefit of 96.40, an allowed amount of 161.30 and a primary payment of 87.25:
- under non-duplication the plan pays 96.40 less 87.25, which is 9.15;
- under standard coordination of benefits the plan pays the lesser of 96.40 and 161.30 less 87.25 (74.05), which is 74.05.
